name: What types of caulk are best for exterior sliding doors?

mainEntity.name: What types of caulk are best for exterior sliding doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: For exterior sliding doors, durable and weather-resistant caulk types are essential. Silicone caulk is highly recommended due to its excellent flexibility, UV resistance, and longevity, making it ideal for the Bay Area's climate changes. Polyurethane caulk is another strong option, offering superior adhesion and resistance to abrasion. Acrylic latex caulk, while less expensive, is generally not recommended for exterior use due to its lower durability and flexibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Silicone and polyurethane caulks are best for exterior sliding doors due to their flexibility, UV resistance, and durability.
